summary: Any 7-40 char hex word that is not HEAD reads as a different build, so a UUID or container id in the identity output gives a false differs (review finding 4)
A dev server whose identity command reports its startup commit reads as a different build once HEAD moves; with no refresh declared that ends setup-failure (review finding 5)
Debug refresh failure is cleared only by a passing setup check, so a skipped check lets the Judge end setup-failure on unrelated open criteria (review finding 7)
Holder cwd is compared as a plain string, so a dev server run from a submodule reads as another checkout (review finding 8)
On a setup-failure exit, a criterion judged not_met last iteration is rewritten not_verifiable/never-exercised and its failing verdict lost (review finding 9)
